x: Ted Smith was not far behind with Len Demmon and Terry Clark moving up to complete the scoring four. At 3 miles the lads were holding their own and even at this stage it looked as though the team race was in the bag.
Syd James and Hugh McGreechan finished together in 1h. 44m. and Len Demmon and Trevor Luck certainly walked well. Harry Shields, with an allowance of 12 minutes, won the handicap.

The feature of the day was that Len Demmon, known to all as "Last minute Len" actually arrive haf an hour before the train was due to go. This was too much for the rest of the lads who promptly had a whip round and bought him a watch.
